Fields.Name: Time Condition
Fields.Description: When a time-variant row (ID ending 1-9) applies: 0 any time, 1 morning, 2 noon, 3 evening, 4 night, 5 midnight, 6 between the start and end times below. Ignored on other rows.

Fields.Name: Start Hour
Fields.Description: Start of the time range for Time Condition 6 (hour, 0-23). Inclusive.

Fields.Name: Start Minute
Fields.Description: Start of the time range for Time Condition 6 (minute).

Fields.Name: End Hour
Fields.Description: End of the time range for Time Condition 6 (hour). Exclusive; 0:00 means 24:00, and an end before the start wraps past midnight.

Fields.Name: End Minute
Fields.Description: End of the time range for Time Condition 6 (minute).
